name: Negative control (Windows): Get-Date used to timestamp a log line (no T1124 detection)
description: A PowerShell script block that formats a log line with a timestamp, the way scripts commonly use Get-Date. Ground truth: benign scripting, not a standalone system-time query; it tests the precision boundary of rule 100210 (which matches only a script block that IS the time query).
command:
$stamp = (Get-Date).ToString('o')
$line = "jisrsec benign build log entry at $stamp"
$line.Length | Out-Null
